description: A custom Android View class that renders an interactive, zoomable, and scrollable line chart for the function y = x^3 - x/4. It supports gestures like pinch-to-zoom, double tap to zoom, and pan with flings, along with axis labels, grid lines, and edge effects.

classes.name: InteractiveLineGraphView
classes.description: Custom Android View supporting interactive line chart rendering with zoom, pan, gestures, and axis labeling.

classes.name: SavedState
classes.description: Parcelable class for persisting the view's viewport state across configuration changes.

classes.name: AxisStops
classes.description: Data structure representing axis label stops and formatting details.

methods.name: initPaints
methods.description: Initializes or reinitializes the Paint objects based on current attribute values.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Handles size change, updates content drawing rectangle.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Calculates view dimensions, considering minimum chart size and padding.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Main drawing method, rendering axes, grid, labels, data series, and edge effects.

methods.name: drawAxes
methods.description: Draws grid lines, axis labels, and tick marks.

methods.name: drawDataSeriesUnclipped
methods.description: Draws the mathematical function over the current viewport.

methods.name: drawEdgeEffectsUnclipped
methods.description: Draws glow effects at scroll limits if overscrolled.

methods.name: hitTest
methods.description: Checks if a pixel coordinate is within the chart area and converts it to chart data point.

methods.name: onTouchEvent
methods.description: Handles touch events, delegating to gesture detectors.

methods.name: constrainViewport
methods.description: Ensures the current viewport stays within defined axis boundaries.

methods.name: getCurrentViewport
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current viewport rectangle.

methods.name: setCurrentViewport
methods.description: Sets the viewport to a given rectangle and constrains it.

methods.name: zoomIn
methods.description: Programmatically zooms in on the chart.

methods.name: zoomOut
methods.description: Programmatically zooms out on the chart.

methods.name: panLeft
methods.description: Fling gesture to pan the chart left.

methods.name: panRight
methods.description: Fling gesture to pan the chart right.

methods.name: panUp
methods.description: Fling gesture to pan the chart upward.

methods.name: panDown
methods.description: Fling gesture to pan the chart downward.

methods.name: computeScrollSurfaceSize
methods.description: Calculates the size of the scrollable surface in pixels based on current viewport zoom.

methods.name: computeScroll
methods.description: Handles ongoing fling and zoom animations, updating the viewport.

methods.name: setViewportBottomLeft
methods.description: Sets the viewport bottom-left coordinate, constraining within axes.
